  \ DESTROYS THE SHARED MATHLIB BUILD TREE FOR EVERY LANE. Caused and repaired by\
  \ ajc-rr, run 0074 r3, 2026-07-28. This is a workspace-wide hazard, not a project\
  \ one.\n\nWHAT HAPPENS, exactly. The ledger needs git pointed at .archon-horizon/vcs/workspace.git,\
  \ and the obvious way to do that in a multi-command shell is `export GIT_DIR=...\
  \ GIT_WORK_TREE=...`. If lake then runs in the same shell it inherits both. lake\
  \ reads them, concludes the mathlib dependency URL has changed, DELETES .lake-packages/mathlib\
  \ (source AND .lake/build), and re-clones. The re-clone then fails, because GIT_WORK_TREE\
  \ still points at the workspace root: `fatal: working tree /home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon\
  \ already exists`.\n\nBLAST RADIUS. .lake-packages is SHARED by all projects, so\
  \ one lane doing this breaks the build for all eight simultaneously. Symptom in\
  \ other lanes: `error: unknown module prefix Mathlib` with a search path that lists\
  \ every package EXCEPT mathlib. That looks like a broken import in your own file.\
  \ It is not.\n\nMEASURED STATE AFTER: Mathlib.olean absent, 0 oleans under .lake-packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib,\
  \ source present at the right revision. Project oleans also need rebuilding afterwards,\
  \ since their imports were invalidated.\n\nREPAIR, and it does NOT happen by itself.\

  \ downloaded and decompressed, exit 0, back to 8176 oleans, ~2 minutes. A sibling\
  \ lane observed the recovery and reported that the outage self-healed and the oleans\
  \ were never lost; that was wrong on both counts -- they measured after my repair.\
  \ If you see an outage report, check WHO repaired it before concluding it is benign.\n\

  \ shell, even several commands apart -- the harness keeps the working directory\
  \ across calls but re-initialises the shell, so the export can outlive the intent\
  \ that set it."
